positions.as_written: Expect a chronically deficient knee to be more lax than an acutely injured one.
Measure slope where laxity exceeds what the injury explains.
Treat examination under anaesthetic as the more complete structural assessment.
Treat secondary restraint injury as the commonest reason a reconstruction underperforms without a technical error.
Measure slope before revising a graft that failed without a new injury.
Repair the secondary restraints at the index operation rather than later.
